verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth is explicitly documented as local-first/offline: TOTP/HOTP/Steam Guard codes are generated on-device (2fas-docs-37), no login/account is required to use the app (2fas-docs-28, 2fas-docs-27), and the runtime probe confirms 'local-first by design, no agent-callable endpoint for token generation' with no public API (2fas-probe-rt-1). Cloud sync (iCloud/Google Drive) is optional, not required for code generation (2fas-docs-23). missing for 10: no independent hands-on test explicitly verifying TOTP generation with airplane mode/no network, and community discussion focuses on 2FAS Pass (password manager) sync architecture rather than confirming Auth's offline TOTP behavior directly.
